context: A boss and his manager review a listing
purpose: Teach: 東証/スミス/代目/号線/密着/遠藤/田村/高田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うちの会社、東証上場、三代目で実現か。
lines.en: Our company — TSE listing achieved under the third generation.
lines.style: Measured announcement. Slight weight on 「東証上場」. Composed pride without triumphalism. Even pace, steady eye contact. The tone of someone stating fact that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。引受主幹事のスミス証券、密着して支援してくれます。
lines.en: Yes. Smith Securities, the lead underwriter, is supporting us closely.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Crisp delivery. Slight emphasis on the partnership reliability. Steady, attentive — no elaboration, no hesitation. The precision of someone tracking details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広報、遠藤さんに引き続き任せる。
lines.style: Decisive delegation. Light tap of finality on the name. Calm authority — not asking, confirming confidence. Brief, clear, moving forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。田村さんが、IR資料を担当します。
lines.en: Yes. Tamura will handle the IR materials.
lines.style: Straightforward confirmation. Slight nod of competence in the delivery. Clean, methodical — moving through the checklist without dragging. Professional comfort.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社、移転先は新青梅街道沿い、5号線近くだったな。
lines.en: The new headquarters — along New Ome Highway, near Route 5.
lines.style: Recalling out loud. Slight pause after the dash, like he's visualizing. Conversational, not stiff. A detail he's turned over in his mind before. Steady, geographic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物流の高田さん、地理に強いので相談を。
lines.en: Yes. Takada from logistics knows the area well — you might consult with him.
lines.style: Practical suggestion. Understated recommendation. Light ease in the tone — solving a problem before it becomes one. Professional warmth without slowing the pace.
